# English: All the subjects make me smart.
Chinese: 所有学科都让我变聪明。

# English: All year long, we have fun.
Chinese: 一年到头，我们都很快乐。

# English: Because my students are very bright!
Chinese: 因为我的学生们非常聪明！

# English: Bobby, save your money for a rainy day.
Chinese: Bobby，把钱存起来以备不时之需。

# English: Check your bag. It's time for school.
Come on, Mike! It's time for class!
Come to school and learn with me.
Chinese: 来学校和我一起学习吧。

# English: Don't be late! That's the rule.
Don't worry. I have an umbrella with me.
Get up now-it's time to go.
Good idea! What's the weather like?
Good morning, Bingbing. It's seven twenty. Let's have breakfast.
Chinese: 早上好，冰冰。七点二十了。我们吃早餐吧。

# English: Good morning, Bobby! I get up at five!
Good morning, Mr Wilson. When do you get up every day?
Chinese: 早上好，Wilson 先生。你每天什么时候起床？

# English: Good morning, Mum. What time is it?
Great! Let's go to the sports ground.
Ha ha! They're my father's shorts.
Chinese: 哈哈！它们是我爸爸的短裤。

# English: Happy New Year, Mrs Fox. I like your sunglasses!
Chinese: 新年快乐，Fox 夫人。我喜欢你的太阳镜！

# English: Happy New Year, boys and girls!
Hello! Welcome to my home. We can play together.
Chinese: 你好！欢迎来到我家。我们可以一起玩。

# English: Hi, Mike! Do you like playing ping-pong?
Hi, Su Hai! Happy Chinese New Year!
Hi, Su Hai! Let's go to the park today.
Chinese: 嗨，Su Hai！我们今天去公园吧。

# English: I also have an umbrella. We can share it.
Chinese: 我也有一把伞。我们可以共用它。

# English: I can't be late for school again!

Chinese: 我最喜欢语文。我想学习中国文化。

# English: I like Chinese. I like PE.
Chinese: 我喜欢语文。我喜欢体育。

# English: I like English best. I like reading English stories.
Chinese: 我最喜欢英语。我喜欢读英语故事。

# English: I like Maths. I'm good at it. What subject do you like best?
Chinese: 我喜欢数学。我擅长数学。你最喜欢什么学科？

# English: I like Music. I like Art.
Chinese: 我喜欢音乐。我喜欢美术。

# English: I like Science best. It's interesting.
Chinese: 我最喜欢科学。它很有趣。

# English: I like football. I like swimming.
Chinese: 我喜欢足球。我喜欢游泳。

# English: I like playing basketball. Do you like playing basketball?
Chinese: 我喜欢打篮球。你喜欢打篮球吗？

# English: I like playing ping-pong too. Let's go and play.
Chinese: 我也喜欢打乒乓球。我们去玩吧。

# English: I like running. I like jumping.
Chinese: 我喜欢跑步。我喜欢跳跃。

# English: I like sport. It's good for us.
Chinese: 我喜欢运动。运动对我们有好处。

# English: I want a red toy car.
Chinese: 我想要一辆红色玩具汽车。
它是 Su Yang 的吗？

# English: It is autumn. It is cool.
It is spring again. The birds are back.
Chinese: 又是春天了。鸟儿们回来了。

# English: It is spring. It is warm.
It is summer. It is hot.
It is winter. It is cold.
It's Friday today. Let's go to the cinema after school.
Chinese: 今天是星期五。放学后我们去电影院吧。

# English: It's a good idea, but I have a dancing lesson today. I have two dancing lessons every week.
Chinese: 这是个好主意，但是我今天有舞蹈课。我每周有两节舞蹈课。

# English: It's four thirty. It's time for sport.
It's nine o'clock. It's time for bed.
It's six fifteen. It's time to have dinner.
Chinese: 六点十五分了。该吃晚饭了。

# English: Let's go and draw pictures there!
Let's go to the sports ground!
Let's keep fit. Run, run, run!
Chinese: 让我们保持健康。跑，跑，跑！

# English: Look at the doll. Look at the robot.
Chinese: 看这个玩具娃娃。看这个机器人。

# English: Look at this robot. His face is cute.
Chinese: 看这个机器人。他的脸很可爱。

# English: Look! This is my father's new shirt. And this is my mother's coat.
Chinese: 看！这是我爸爸的新衬衫。这是我妈妈的外套。

# English: Look, boys and girls. We have Chinese, Maths, English and Science. We also have Art, PE and Music.
Chinese: 看，同学们。我们有语文、数学、英语和科学。我们还有美术、体育和音乐。

# English: Me too. I also like IT.
Chinese: 我也是。我也喜欢信息科技课。

# English: Me too. I like swimming and playing ping-pong. What about you?
Chinese: 我也是。我喜欢游泳和打乒乓球。你呢？

# English: Mum, do you like our dolls?
Chinese: 妈妈，你喜欢我们的玩具娃娃吗？

# English: My doll is a boy. His eyes are small. His nose is small too. But his mouth is big. His arms and legs are long.
Chinese: 我的玩具娃娃是个男孩。他的眼睛很小。他的鼻子也很小。但是他的嘴巴很大。他的胳膊和腿很长。

# English: My doll is a girl. Look at her lovely face. Her eyes are big. Her nose and mouth are small. Her hair is long.
Chinese: 我的玩具娃娃是个女孩。看她可爱的脸。她的眼睛很大。她的鼻子和嘴巴很小。她的头发很长。

# English: Oh no! It's hard for me.
Chinese: 哦不！这对我来说太难了。

# English: School? What day is it today?

Chinese: 有些人戴酷酷的帽子或穿漂亮的衬衫。

# English: Some wear new dresses or bright skirts.
Chinese: 有些人穿新连衣裙或鲜艳的半身裙。

# English: Sorry, I walk my dog on Tuesday and Friday.
Chinese: 抱歉，我星期二和星期五遛狗。

# English: Sport is cool. Sport is fun.
Thank you! Ping-pong is great fun!
Chinese: 谢谢你！乒乓球非常有趣！

# English: Thank you! Why do I wear sunglasses today? Guess!
Chinese: 谢谢你们！我今天为什么戴太阳镜？猜一猜！

# English: Thanks. We like wearing red clothes at Chinese New Year.
Chinese: 谢谢。我们喜欢在中国新年穿红色衣服。

# English: That's what I love to do!

Chinese: 这个玩具娃娃有长头发。

# English: This is great fun! Can we play again tomorrow?
Chinese: 这太有趣了！我们明天还能再玩吗？

# English: To celebrate in our own special way.
Chinese: 用我们自己的特别方式庆祝。

# English: Today is a rainy day! It's time to buy the toy car!
Chinese: 今天是下雨天！该买玩具汽车了！

# English: Wash your face. Don't be slow.
We can have fun together with our friends. Let's have a show!
Chinese: 我们可以和朋友们一起玩得很开心。我们来办一场表演吧！

We love to dress up on the holiday,
Chinese: 我们喜欢在节日里盛装打扮，

Chinese: 今天天气怎么样？哦，多云。

# English: What's the weather like today? Oh, it's sunny and hot.
Chinese: 今天天气怎么样？哦，晴朗又炎热。

# English: When do you have dancing lessons?
Whose caps are those? They're so cute!
Chinese: 那些是谁的帽子？它们真可爱！

# English: Wow, you have babies! And I have new friends!
Chinese: 哇，你们有宝宝了！我也有新朋友了！

# English: Yes, I do. Ping-pong is fun. But I can't play well.
Chinese: 是的，我喜欢。乒乓球很有趣。但是我打不好。

# English: Yes, I want to go to school early.
Yes, it's lunchtime. Let's go and have lunch.
Chinese: 是的，该吃午饭了。我们去吃午饭吧。

# English: You look cool in the cap. Whose cap is it?
Chinese: 你戴这顶帽子看起来很酷。这是谁的帽子？

# English: You're so tall! Your legs are long.
Your dolls are great. They bring you lots of fun!
Chinese: 你们的玩具娃娃很棒。它们给你们带来很多乐趣！

# English: Your trousers are so big. Whose trousers are these?
Chinese: 你的裤子真大。这是谁的裤子？
